The camping site has become an important part of daily life. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The bird-watching spot looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, someone called an ambulance at once.

Little by little, things began to change. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. On Friday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Also, grandma still calls the refrigerator the icebox out of habit.
Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Nina's dream job is to be a doctor. Lily advised Nina to try cooking as a new hobby. Best of all, the mountain is covered with snow.

Nina is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Nina thanked Lily for the honest advice. The clinic helps each amputee adjust to a prosthetic leg.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Nina often share different ideas about the bird-watching spot. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
